name: Gotham Vertical
description: The Gotham Vertical is a compact HF vertical antenna that uses a mid‑mounted loading coil to achieve resonance on lower HF bands. It is known for its small physical size and moderate performance when installed with adequate radials.
modelingNotes: Loading coil inductance determines resonant frequency.
Coil position affects current distribution and efficiency.
Ground-mounted installations require many radials for good performance.
Losses in the loading coil significantly reduce efficiency.
Short verticals have low radiation resistance and must be modeled carefully.
Height above ground influences takeoff angle and pattern shape.
